references.observed_heading: KILO SALE / BLOCKBUSTER AASHADAM NO.1 / UPTO 66% OFF
references.mobile_variant: web-banner-mobile2-6a4cf1cb67af2.webp (2:3, 800x1200) — genuine re-layout, not a crop
references.subject: woman in saree
references.composition: model hard-left leaning on a 3-D block; extruded gold KILO SALE lettering centre-left; logo centre-bottom; discount type right
references.lighting: flat studio cut-out, no environmental integration
references.palette: teal to orange to green gradient, gold, white
references.commercial_purpose: price-led Aashadam festival sale with weight-based pricing gimmick
references.what_works: regional calendar anchoring; unmistakable single mechanic
references.what_to_avoid: zero negative space; all copy rasterised with empty alt; cut-out compositing

references.observed_heading: Timeless Tradition / Modern Elegance / Exquisite silks for every celebration
references.subject: two women in silk sarees
references.wardrobe: green-and-gold and purple-and-gold Kanchipuram silks, zari pallu fanned across the floor
references.composition: subjects right-of-centre, one seated one perched; vignetted dark-green left third holds the type
references.palette: deep green, purple, antique gold, brass
references.background: built South Indian courtyard — carved wooden door, brass lamps and urulis, marigold, tropical foliage, stone floor
references.what_works: pallu deliberately fanned so the border is the hero rather than the face; type given its own empty third; best textile rendering in the study
references.what_to_avoid: empty alt; prop density edges toward set-dressing cliche

references.observed_heading: The Perfect Start to Forever / Luxury wedding fashion for every celebration
references.subject: bride and groom
references.wardrobe: groom in maroon bandhgala with brooch; bride in pink-and-gold Kanchipuram with red contrast blouse, temple jewellery, maang tikka, jhumkas
references.composition: couple tightly framed together in the left third; right half deliberately empty for type with hairline rules
references.background: painted mandapam backdrop — carved pillar, hanging jasmine-and-rose garlands, scenic canvas dissolving to bokeh
references.what_works: cleanest composition in the study — one subject block, one type block; strong information hierarchy
references.what_to_avoid: painted-canvas backdrop reads as studio not occasion; bandhgala is North-Indian-leaning styling

references.observed_heading: Tradition / Woven in style / Crafted for the Modern Gentleman
references.subject: two men in ethnic wear
references.wardrobe: navy silk kurta with gold-embroidered Nehru jacket; slate floral-print kurta with white churidar and juttis
references.composition: symmetric left/right models, centre reserved for type on a pale-pink arch
references.lighting: soft warm single key from front-left
references.background: built studio set — peach gradient wall, pink arch, palm frond, pampas, ceramic bowl, plinth
references.what_works: most brand-grade frame on that site; generous centre negative space; menswear treated with real production value
references.what_to_avoid: Nehru-jacket styling is North-Indian-leaning; studio set rather than real environment

references.observed_heading: wedding Mahotsav / A new wedding collection for this wedding season.
references.subject: bride, groom and celebrity
references.wardrobe: groom in cream silk kurta with angavastram; bride in gold/multi Kanchipuram with magenta blouse; celebrity in black bandhgala
references.composition: couple left, celebrity right, two stacked campaign cards centre
references.palette: cream, gold, magenta, forest green, sky blue
references.background: composited palace terrace — stone lion, Corinthian pillar, balustrade, flower beds
references.what_works: naming the campaign ('Mahotsav') gives the season an identity; the one genuinely South Indian groom styling found (silk kurta + angavastram)
references.what_to_avoid: palace cliche; celebrity re-use; stray '*Conditions apply' in the margin; no wedding page behind the campaign

references.mobile_variant: mobile.jpg (700x1027) — different composition, waist-up, logo removed
references.subject: woman in bridal Kanchipuram
references.wardrobe: pink/gold/green brocade Kanchipuram, full temple jewellery set — long haaram, choker, jhumkas, maang tikka, vaddanam
references.composition: seated on a flower-garlanded swing, subject right third, logo placed in left negative space over a pond
references.palette: pink, gold, sage green, cream, pale blue
references.background: neoclassical white colonnade, lily pond with swans, rose and bougainvillea garlands, sunset sky
references.what_works: strongest bridal-credibility asset found; the mobile re-cut prioritises brocade and jewellery legibility at thumb size
references.what_to_avoid: jewellery intensity competes with the weave; neoclassical colonnade is not South Indian vernacular; slide is not a link

references.observed_heading: BLOCKBUSTER AADI KG SALE / 69% off / 2nd saree Rs. 9 (Telugu)
references.subject: woman in saree with balance scale
references.wardrobe: magenta/gold Kanchipuram-style silk, temple jewellery, jasmine
references.composition: model centre-right holding a balance scale — sarees on one pan, a 1 KG weight on the other; sale lockup left; Telugu offer type right
references.what_works: the balance-scale device makes an abstract pricing mechanic instantly legible; Telugu-first copy; state footprint stated
references.what_to_avoid: no negative space; whole message rasterised; the slide is not clickable; value-retail register would destroy a premium position

references.observed_heading: none — no copy, no offer, no logo
references.subject: man in silk kurta (celebrity)
references.wardrobe: royal-blue silk kurta with silver thread work, holding a gold kalash with temple jewellery and a lotus
references.composition: subject centre-right, mid-thigh up; left half intentionally empty bokeh with nothing placed in it
references.negative_space: left half — the largest clean negative space found in the study
references.lighting: soft warm key with rim — the most premium lighting on that site
references.palette: dusty pink, cream, cobalt blue, gold
references.background: heavily bokeh'd pink-and-white floral mandapam with warm string-light orbs
references.what_works: proves a pure brand frame with no offer can sit in a commercial carousel; the empty half is exactly the composition Ananthula's hero uses
references.what_to_avoid: the negative space is wasted — nothing is placed in it and the slide is not a link

references.observed_heading: Elegance is when beauty speaks in silence
references.subject: woman in pattu saree
references.wardrobe: mustard-yellow Kanchi-style silk with deep teal contrast border and pallu, gold temple jewellery, jasmine
references.composition: subject left-of-centre occupying left 55%, framed copy card lower-right
references.negative_space: right third plus wall above subject
references.lighting: warm directional side light with visible cast shadows on plaster — the most photographic asset on that site
references.palette: sandstone beige, gold, marigold yellow, teal, brass
references.background: temple-style archway, carved pillars, marigold torans, brass diyas and urli, tropical foliage
references.what_works: real cast shadows and a warm side key; the only frame carrying South Indian ritual context on that site; contrast-border colourway is memorable

references.observed_heading: Tradition Never Goes Out of Style
references.subject: two men in wedding sherwanis
references.wardrobe: ivory tone-on-tone chikankari-style sherwanis, one with draped dupatta, one with layered open jacket, churidar; no turban or garland
references.composition: pair on left third, generous copy field right
references.palette: cream, ivory, champagne, brass, brown type
references.background: ivory Mughal-arch panelling with gold trellis, brass lanterns, white floral urn
references.what_works: strongest groom frame in the study; ivory palette separates cleanly from bridal arakku; restraint (no turban, no garland)
references.what_to_avoid: Mughal-arch and sherwani are North Indian visual language — the exact default Ananthula must avoid; no groom collection exists behind it

references.observed_heading: Grace In Every Drape / Beauty In Every Detail
references.mobile_variant: lehenga-mobile-6a313516b15cb.webp (3840x5760, 2:3) — drops one of the two models entirely rather than cropping
references.subject: two women in lehengas
references.wardrobe: red-orange heavily embroidered lehenga; lilac net lehenga with sequin jaal and dupatta
references.composition: symmetrical bookend — model far left, model far right, copy dead centre
references.negative_space: entire centre third (~35%) reserved for type
references.lighting: soft flat studio key, minimal shadow, composited cut-outs
references.palette: warm grey-green plaster, terracotta, red-orange, dusty lilac
references.background: painted studio backdrop with panelled door, potted plants, tiled floor — clearly composited
references.what_works: the mobile variant is the clearest proof of true re-art-direction in the study — a different edit of the same shoot, one model instead of two
references.what_to_avoid: composited cut-outs with no cast shadow; the hero lands on a generic /collections/women because no lehenga collection exists

references.observed_heading: Celebrate Every Occasion with Chandana Brothers Fashion for the family
references.mobile_variant: none — same asset, object-fit cover, outer family members clipped on desktop
references.subject: family of four
references.wardrobe: mother in emerald Kanjeevaram pattu with wide gold zari border and full gold set; father in denim shirt and dark jeans; son ~7-8 in neon lime hoodie and joggers; daughter ~9-10 in cream floral dress with cropped denim jacket
references.composition: four cut-out figures in a connected hand-holding chain across the frame, both parents carrying CB-branded shopping bags
references.negative_space: flat beige ground with faint mandala texture and a red ribbon swoosh behind the heads
references.lighting: soft flat near-shadowless, identical across four separately-lit subjects
references.palette: emerald green, denim blue, neon lime, cream, maroon
references.what_works: deliberate wardrobe NON-coordination is the single best strategic idea found in the study — traditional mother, Western father, sportswear son, denim daughter says 'we dress all of you, however each of you dresses', with no copy
references.what_to_avoid: reads as composited/AI — hard cut edges with no cast shadow, no ground perspective, eyelines landing on nothing, four identical simultaneous smiles, logo artwork flat on the bag folds; NO GRANDPARENT despite a '50+ Years' and 'Style for Every Generation' claim; only one of four wears the flagship category; alt text is a leftover from a jewellery template

references.subject: child (boy ~7-9)
references.wardrobe: yellow kurta-pyjama with cream geometric-brocade Nehru jacket, gold mojari
references.composition: single child centred, symmetrical, full-length, arms straight down, weight evenly planted, chin level, closed-mouth smile to lens
references.background: marigold-garlanded doorway, brass lamp stacks, patterned floor tile, stone elephant balustrades, rangoli — pixel-identical to the pattu-sets.webp backdrop
references.what_works: nothing significant — it is a garment record
references.what_to_avoid: child used as a mannequin: no movement, no play, no interaction, no prop, no reason to be there; everything interesting is behind him; the shared identical backdrop across images reveals a synthetic or supplier-catalogue set

references.subject: flat-lay product still, no child
references.composition: flat-lay — tee, teddy bear, knit pompom beanie, wooden toy camera, alphabet blocks
references.what_works: nothing — the filename is a verbatim Unsplash photo ID, rehosted
references.what_to_avoid: the Kids Wear tile of a South Indian family retailer contains no child, no Indian product, and represents an age group (newborn) the brand's single kids tile (boys ~8) does not serve; rehosted Western stock as a category hero is a credibility collapse
